47001.synonym: pubba, pubbaka, pubbatara, purāṇa, purimaka, porāṇa

examples.text: yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi
purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse, ej'ānugā te na taranti saṅgaṃ, te uggahāyanti nirassajanti, kapī'va sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāyaṃ.

tena kho pana samayena dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchat'eva purimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati adho, gacchati anudisaṃ.
sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehipi pādehi kammaṃ karoti

47004.commentary: (ANa) vass'ūpanāyikā'ti vass'ūpagamanāni. purimikā'ti apar'ajjugatāya āsāḷhiyā upagantabbā purimakattikapuṇṇamipariyosānā paṭhamā temāsī. pacchimikā'ti māsagatāya āsāḷhiyā upagantabbā pacchimakattikapariyosānā pacchimā temāsī'ti.

examples.text: katamā dve? purimikā ca pacchimikā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve vass'ūpanāyikā'ti.

47005.meaning1: fruit of former deeds; consequence of past actions

examples.text: lābhī acchādana-vattha-mokkhapāvuraṇānaṃ, bhavati yadi anāgāriyataṃ upeti, sahito purimakataphalaṃ anubhavati, na bhavati katassa panāso'ti.

47006.meaning1: former talk; what was said before

examples.text: (purimakasadisaṃ uddānaṃ.)

47008.meaning1: (of animals) front of the body; fore-body

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā laṅghati purimakāyaṃ paggaṇhati purime pāde. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamo assadoso.
purimagamane aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇā, dutiyagamane chabbīsaṃ vitthāretabbāni.

47010.meaning1: first tetrad; previous group of four

examples.text: ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, purimajātiyā manussaloke.

47012.commentary: (MNt) purimataṇhā'ti purimataresu bhavesu nibbattā paccuppann'attabhāvahetubhūtā taṇhā. taggahaṇen'eva ca atīt'addhasaṅgahā avijjāsaṅkhārā saddhiṃ upādānena saṅgahitā'ti daṭṭhabbā.

examples.text: nandī dukkhassa mūlan'ti-ādīsu ca nandī'ti purimataṇhā. dukkhan'ti pañcakkhandhā.

evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?
akkodhañ'ca adhiṭṭhahi adāsi, dānañ'ca vatthāni sukhumāni succhavīni, purimatarabhave ṭhito abhivissaji, mahim'iva suro abhivassaṃ.

47015.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of purimatara
47015.commentary: (DNt) tato paran'ti hiyyo'ti vuttadivasato anantaraṃ paraṃ purimataraṃ atisayena purimattā.

examples.text: kumāro aññātaṃ bhagavā, aññātaṃ sugatā'ti vatvā ahaṃ, bhante, purimataraṃ gantvā vihāraṃ kāremi

47019.meaning1: in exactly the same way as before; precisely in the previous manner

examples.text: saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti idhā'pi purimanayen'eva attho veditabbo. yathā hi pubbe vippaṭisārakaraṃ ārammaṇaṃ dasseti, evam'idhā'pi pasādakaraṃ.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati? yañ'ca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa purim'ante udakaṃ, yañ'ca pacchim'ante udakaṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

47022.meaning1: who ordained before; who went forth previously
47022.meaning2: who ordained before; who went forth previously

examples.text: purimapabbajitānaṃ dhamm'ābhisamayo

puna caparaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. tassa yā purimasaññā, sā nirujjhati.
[peyyālena pana purimasutte viya nigamanaṃ dassitaṃ]
(yathā purimasutt'antaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ)
(purimavagge viya aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇāni vitthāretabbānī'ti.)

47028.meaning1: previous detailed exposition; former in depth analysis

examples.text: (purimaveyyākaraṇena ekanidānaṃ).

47029.meaning1: previous way of talking; former mode of communication; previous verbal dealings
47029.commentary: (ANa) purimavohārā pacchimavohāran'ti purimakathāya pacchimakathaṃ, purimakathāya ca pacchimakathā, pacchimakathāya ca purimakathā na sametī'ti attho.

examples.text: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.
purimā koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti.

47031.synonym: jana, jantu, nara, pumu, manussa, mānusa

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.
saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.
409, 441. sabbesam'ek'ābhidhāne paro puriso.

sabbesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ paṭhamamajjhim'uttamapurisānaṃ ek'ābhidhāne paro puriso gahetabbo. so ca paṭhati, tvañ'ca paṭhasi, tumhe paṭhatha. so ca pacati, tvañ'ca pacasi. tumhe pacatha. evaṃ sesāsu vibhattīsu paro puriso yojetabbo.

sā tattha rajjati tatr'ābhiramati. sā tattha rattā tatr'ābhiratā bahiddhā puris'indriyaṃ manasi karoti, purisakuttaṃ puris'ākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ puris'ālaṅ'kāraṃ. sā tattha rajjati tatr'ābhiramati.

yathā yathā kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā taṃbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañ'c'eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha, itthiyā ca itthiliṅgaṃ pāturahosi purisassa ca purisaliṅgaṃ.

47036.meaning1: thoroughbred of a man; noble man

examples.text: yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47037.commentary: (DNa) mahārājānaṃ purisakānan'ti aṭṭhavīsati-yakkhasenāpatīnaṃ. purisakānan'ti yakkhasenāpatīnaṃ ye manassā tesaṃ.

examples.text: te kho te, mārisa, mahācorā rañño māgadhassa avaruddhā nāma vuccanti. evam'eva kho, mārisa, santi amanussā caṇḍā ruddhā rabhasā, te n'eva mahārājānaṃ ādiyanti, na mahārājānaṃ purisakānaṃ ādiyanti, na mahārājānaṃ purisakānaṃ purisakānaṃ ādiyanti.

seyyath'idaṃ… gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ purisakathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ

47040.commentary: (ANa) purisakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti mahākukkuṭaṃ ravantaṃ disvā imassa'pi dve pādā dve pakkhā, mayham'pi tath'eva, aham'pi evarūpaṃ ravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti sā tassa sammukhā ravituṃ asakkontī tasmiṃ pakkante ravamānā kukkuṭikāravaṃ'y'eva ravi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso sarabha, ambukasañcarī purisakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravati, evam'evaṃ kho tvaṃ, āvuso sarabha, aññatr'eva samaṇena gotamena purisakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti, ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravasi.

47041.commentary: (DNa) n'atthi purisakāre'ti yena purisakārena sattā vuttappakārā sampattiyo pāpuṇanti, tam'pi paṭikkhipati.

examples.text: n'atthi hetu, n'atthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, ahetū apaccayā sattā visujjhanti. n'atthi attakāre, n'atthi parakāre, n'atthi purisakāre, n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo.
yo ca sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca, tiṇā bhiyyo na maññati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, so sukhā na vihāyati.

evam'evaṃ kho, sandha, idh'ekacco purisakhaḷuṅko araññagato'pi rukkhamūlagato'pi suññ'āgāragato'pi kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, na sarāmī'ti asatiyā nibbeṭheti.

47045.meaning1: thinking of an unbroken man; meditation of an untrained man

examples.text: idhalokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, paralokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'pi nissāya jhāyati. evaṃ kho, sandha, purisakhaḷuṅkajhāyitaṃ hoti.

47048.meaning1: smell of a man; male scent

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekagandham'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, purisagandho. purisagandho, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.
bandheyyuṃ vā'ti rajjubandhanena vā andubandhanena vā saṅkhalikabandhanena vā gharabandhanena vā nagarabandhanena vā gāmabandhanena vā nigamabandhanena vā bandheyyuṃ, purisaguttiṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
sā itthicittaṃ virājetvā purisacittaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā.

47051.meaning1: male state; fact of being male

examples.text: ahañ'hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ sakkassa devānam'indassa puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā.

47052.commentary: (VINa) puris'atthakaran'ti purisena kātabbaṃ hatthakammaṃ vuccati, taṃ yācituṃ vaṭṭati. hatthakammaṃ nāma kiñci vatthu na hoti, tasmā ṭhapetvā migaluddaka-macchabandhak'ādīnaṃ sakakammaṃ avasesaṃ sabbaṃ kappiyaṃ.

examples.text: saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.

47053.meaning1: wanting a man; in need of a worker

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, gāmaṇi, evaṃ vadāmi, tiṇaṃ tiṇ'atthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, dāru dāru'tthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, sakaṭaṃ sakaṭ'atthikena pariyesitabbaṃ, puriso puris'atthikena pariyesitabbo.

appaṭivānī sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, padahāmi, kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.
yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47056.meaning1: person in training; person to be tamed
47056.meaning2: person to be trained or converted

examples.text: evam'eva kho brāhmaṇa tathāgato purisadammaṃ labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ vineti, ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavā hohi
tathāgatena hi, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena purisadammo sārito aṭṭha disā vidhāvati.

47057.meaning2: guide of men who are to be restrained

examples.text: tatra idaṃ nissāya idaṃ pajahatha, tayo satipaṭṭhānā yadariyo sevati yadariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam'anusāsitum'arahati, so vuccati yoggācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathī'ti, ayam'uddeso saḷāyatanavibhaṅgassa.
so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti.

47059.meaning1: fault of man; defect of man

examples.text: aṭṭha ca, bhikkhave, assakhaḷuṅke desessāmi aṭṭha ca assadose, aṭṭha ca purisakhaḷuṅke aṭṭha ca purisadose. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
katame ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭha purisakhaḷuṅkā aṭṭha ca purisadosā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, na sarāmī'ti asatiyā nibbeṭheti.

47060.meaning1: ox of a man; beast of burden of a man

examples.text: yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47061.meaning1: dragon of a man; noble man

examples.text: yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47062.meaning1: chief bull of man; foremost of men

examples.text: yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47063.meaning1: among men; (comm) with a male driver

47064.meaning1: woman in the midst of men; woman among men
47064.construction:
purisa + antara + gata + ā
purisantaragata + ā

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya

47065.meaning1: human courage; human power; manly effort

examples.text: appaṭivānī sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, padahāmi, kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.

47066.meaning1: man among men; thoroughbred among men

examples.text: tayo ca, bhikkhave, assaparasse desessāmi tayo ca purisaparasse. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

47068.meaning1: understanding of the superior and inferior faculties of individuals
47068.commentary: (ANa) ke ca purisapuggala-paropariya-ñāṇe'ti ettha purisapuggalaparopariyañāṇaṃ vuccati purisapuggalānaṃ tikkhamuduvasena indriyaparopariyañāṇaṃ. tasmā kā ca bālā migasālā, ke ca purisapuggalānaṃ indriyaparopariyañāṇe appaṭihatavisayā sammāsambuddhā, ubhayam'etaṃ dūre suvidūre'ti ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.

47069.meaning1: touch of man; male physical contact

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekaphoṭṭhabbam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, purisaphoṭṭhabbo. purisaphoṭṭhabbo, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

47070.meaning1: level of men; state of men
47070.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo'ti mandabhūmi khiḍḍābhūmi vīmaṃsakabhūmi ujugatabhūmi sekkhabhūmi samaṇabhūmi jinabhūmi pannabhūmī'ti imā aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo'ti vadati.

examples.text: pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca, dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā, dvaṭṭh'antarakappā, chaḷābhijātiyo, aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo, ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate

47071.commentary: (VIN 1.2.5) itthiyā vā purisamatin'ti purisassa matiṃ itthiyā āroceti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅ'khaṇikāya'pi, saṅgh'ādiseso.

47072.commentary: (SNa) dvīhi pariyaññehi yajitabbassa ekavīsatiyūpassa ekasmiṃ majjhimadivaseyeva satta-navuti-pañca-pasu-sata-ghāta-bhiṃsanassa ṭhapetvā bhūmiñ'ca purise ca avasesa-sabba-vibhava-dakkhiṇassa yaññass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. purisam'ettha medhantī'ti purisamedho.

examples.text: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.

47073.meaning1: pair of people; pair of individuals
47073.commentary: (MNa) purisayuge'ti vaṃsasambhave purise. (ITIa) cattāri purisayugānī'ti yugaḷavasena paṭhamamagg'aṭṭho paṭhamaphal'aṭṭho'ti idam'ekaṃ yugaḷaṃ, yāva catutthamagg'aṭṭho catutthaphal'aṭṭho'ti idam'ekaṃ yugaḷa'nti evaṃ cattāri purisayugāni.

examples.text: yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti

yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi, mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosi. yasmiṃ kho, tāta kumāra, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vattassa samucchedo hoti so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.

47074.meaning1: pair of people; pair of individuals

47075.meaning1: yoked by a man; (comm) yoked with a bull

47076.meaning1: taste of a man; male flavour

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekarasam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, purisaraso. purisaraso, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

47077.meaning1: masculine form; image of a man

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… usulakkhaṇaṃ dhanulakkhaṇaṃ āvudhalakkhaṇaṃ itthilakkhaṇaṃ purisalakkhaṇaṃ kumāralakkhaṇaṃ kumārilakkhaṇaṃ dāsalakkhaṇaṃ dāsilakkhaṇaṃ

yathā yathā kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā taṃbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañ'c'eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha, itthiyā ca itthiliṅgaṃ pāturahosi purisassa ca purisaliṅgaṃ.

47081.meaning1: perceiving as a man; regarding as male

47082.meaning1: group of one hundred people; crowd of one hundred men (of)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idha rājā khattiyo muddh'āvasitto nānājaccānaṃ purisānaṃ purisasataṃ sannipāteyya

47083.meaning1: human thoroughbred; thoroughbred of a man
47083.commentary: (ANa) assaparasse'ti assesu parasse. purisaparasse'ti purisesu parasse, purisapurise'ti attho.

examples.text: tayo ca, bhikkhave, assasadasse desessāmi tayo ca purisasadasse. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.

47084.meaning1: sound of a man; male noise

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekasaddam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, purisasaddo. purisasaddo, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

47085.meaning1: together with a person; accompanied by a man

examples.text: yadā kira, bho, ayaṃ saṅkho nāma purisasahagato ca hoti vāyāmasahagato ca vāyusahagato ca, tadāyaṃ saṅkho saddaṃ karoti, yadā pan'āyaṃ saṅkho n'eva purisasahagato hoti na vāyāmasahagato na vāyusahagato, n'āyaṃ saṅkho saddaṃ karotī'ti.

47086.commentary: (VVt) sadd'attho pana evaṃ veditabbo, purisasaṃsaṭṭhan'ti paripuṇṇavīsativassena purisena ananulomikena kāyavacīkammena saṃsaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, purisasīlasamācāre.
yo evarūpaṃ purisanāgaṃ purisasīhaṃ purisaājānīyaṃ purisanisabhaṃ purisadhorayhaṃ purisadantaṃ atikkamitabbaṃ maññeyya kim'aññatra adassanā'ti.

47092.meaning1: auspicious mark of the foremost of excellent men

examples.text: subhujo susu susaṇṭhito sujāto, mudutalun'aṅguliy'assa honti, dīghā tībhi purisavar'aggalakkhaṇehi, cirayapanāya kumāram'ādisanti.
aṭṭhadoṇaṃ cakkhumato sarīraṃ, sattadoṇaṃ jambudīpe mahenti, ekañ'ca doṇaṃ purisavar'uttamassa, rāmagāme nāgarājā maheti.

47094.commentary: (VINa) viññunā purisaviggahenā'ti viññunā purisena, purisaviggahaṃ gahetvā'pi ṭhitena na yakkhena na petena na tiracchānagatena.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttarichappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahena, pācittiyaṃ.
aññatra viññunā purisaviggahenā'ti ṭhapetvā viññuṃ purisaviggahaṃ. viññū nāma purisaviggaho, paṭibalo hoti subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhull'āduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.

47095.commentary: (DNa) purisavisesaṃ jānātī'ti muggaṃ māsena samaṃ akatvā guṇavisiṭṭhassa visesaṃ jānāti.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno mahājanasaṅgahaṃ samekkhamāno samaṃ jānāti sāmaṃ jānāti, purisaṃ jānāti purisavisesaṃ jānāti, ayam'idam'arahati ayam'idam'arahatī'ti tattha tattha purisavisesakaro ahosi.

47096.meaning1: making distinctions between people; differentiating individuals
47096.commentary: (DNa) purisavisesakaro ahosī'ti purisavisesaṃ ñatvā kārako ahosi. yo yaṃ arahati, tass'eva taṃ adāsi. yo hi kahāpaṇārahassa aḍḍhaṃ deti, so parassa aḍḍhaṃ nāseti. yo dve kahāpaṇe deti, so attano kahāpaṇaṃ nāseti. tasmā idaṃ ubhayam'pi akatvā yo yaṃ arahati, tassa tadeva adāsi.

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno mahājanasaṅgahaṃ samekkhamāno samaṃ jānāti sāmaṃ jānāti, purisaṃ jānāti purisavisesaṃ jānāti, ayam'idam'arahati ayam'idam'arahatī'ti tattha tattha purisavisesakaro ahosi.

appaṭivānī sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, padahāmi, kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
dullabho puris'ājañño, na so sabbattha jāyati, yattha so jāyati dhīro, taṃ kulaṃ sukham'edhati.
namo te puris'ājañña, namo te puris'uttama, yassa te n'ābhijānāma, yam'pi nissāya jhāyasī'ti.
